faqs.question: What is the average fee for share market courses in Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: Published fees commonly range from free self-paced modules to ₹35,000–₹1,00,000+ for mentorship packs. Get quotes in writing and confirm education-only SKUs.

faqs.question: How does CoachingCompare rank share market institutes in Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: We use a 100-point inspection across faculty (20), outcomes signalling (20), study material (15), practice drills (15), infrastructure (10), batch-size ratio (10), and doubt support (10). Criterion pages re-order the same shortlist — positions are editorial, not sponsored.

faqs.question: Should I choose classroom or online share market training in Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: Pick classroom for live chart walkthroughs; pick online / hybrid if work hours clash. Demo both; confirm recording windows. Never treat coaching as investment advice or guaranteed returns.

faqs.question: How do I verify share market course claims or results?
faqs.answer: Ask for recent student outcome examples with consent and whether claims are educational milestones vs trading P&L. Brochure profit posters without year or disclaimer are marketing — not audit evidence.
